tools.name: get_merchant
tools.description: All published facts for one salon by ref "<city>/<vertical>/<slug>" (from search results), with crawl_log (every source fetched or checked, with time, result and the facts it gave) and last_verified_at: address, phone, hours, licence, registry, services with published prices, booking link, per-field

tools.name: list_salons
tools.description: Salons covered (San Francisco), ordered profiled, detailed, then listed, with depth, neighborhood, price floor and range, stylist count, availability basis and freshness, last_verified_at and verification date. Paginated: limit (default 50, max 200), offset, depth=profiled|detailed|listed.

tools.name: get_salon
tools.description: Full record for one salon as markdown: facts, hours, every haircut service with price/duration/inclusions, stylists, policies, attributes, evidence, booking rules, candidate start times from the published schedule. Every fact carries a status tag and date.

tools.name: get_stylist
tools.description: One stylist, under the name the salon's booking system shows: salon, bookable status, specialty evidence with sources, services and prices, candidate start times from the published schedule, and booking link.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: NOT live availability. Use compare_options for budget/extras/date decisions. tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: The salon's own booking URL plus exact remaining steps for a given service, stylist, and start time. This site never books on the user's behalf; precision says how much the link pre-selects.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: A build-time guide snapshot: answer, evidence rows, metrics, source dates and limits. Slugs are listed at /api/v1/guides. No live prices or availability are implied.
